descriptions.d15d_actor_publish_record_80152730: When more than 500 time units have passed since the actor's record time, post the cached message (0x804afdfc, kind 1), copy-construct a local copy of the actor's 184-byte record at +352, set the publication flag 0x804aaae8, assign the copy to the global record 0x8042ff68 (keeping its virtual table word) and destroy the copy, reset the actor's construction words and post a type-5 message (0x80131b50). Partial observed layouts; no owned initialized data.
